_doc: Trailer of AI Nutrition Coach. One entry per scene; each language is a list of sentences (cues). Numbers in words, no exclamation marks. Narrate with the canvas-video skill: narrate.py website/video

en: Know what's on your plate, and keep it yours.
Most food trackers count you down.
Streaks, scores, a red number when you go over.
And your meals live on someone else's server.
Here, you log a meal the way it happened.
Snap the plate, scan a barcode, type it, or just say it.
Each meal lands as one honest plate: four food groups, real grams and nutrients, set calmly against reference intakes.
Then the coach asks one question, instead of handing down a verdict.
Over a week, the pattern shows itself.
No streaks to protect, no badges, just your days side by side.
Your history is encrypted on your device and opened by your passphrase.
The AI is optional, and a photo leaves only when you say so.
It's open source and yours to run: one command on your own server, then install it on every phone in the house.
